title: Saudi International Falcons & Hunting Exhibition
summary: The Saudi International Falcons and Hunting Exhibition is one of the largest events dedicated to falconry and hunting in Saudi and globally. It brings together everything related to falconry and outdoor excursions, from falcons and hunting tools to equipment and gear associated with hunting trips, all within a comprehensive space that allows visitors to explore this field in one place. The exhibition also features platforms showcasing a wide range of brands, alongside accompanying activities and events suitable for families, creating an experience that blends cultural and entertainment elements. The event plays an important role in preserving falconry heritage and raising awareness by offering content that introduces visitors to its history and significance within Saudi’s cultural identity.

title: Saudi Falcons & Hunting Exhibition
summary: International Saudi Falcons and Hunting Exhibition 2026 takes place from October 1 to 10 at the Riyadh Exhibitions and Conferences Center in Malham, bringing together one of the world’s largest events dedicated to falconry heritage, hunting, and outdoor pursuits. Organized by the Saudi Falcons Club, the exhibition reflects the Kingdom’s commitment to preserving national heritage and strengthening its global position in falconry. The event spans culture, entertainment, tourism, and environmental sectors, showcasing a wide selection of falcons, hunting equipment, outdoor gear, and specialist products from local and international brands. It also features dedicated areas for industry displays and commercial platforms representing leading global names in the sector. Designed for enthusiasts and families alike, the exhibition offers a broad visitor experience through interactive activities, heritage showcases, and educational programs that introduce the traditions of falconry and hunting to current and future generations.

title: بي إف إل مينا 11 - نصف النهائي في الرياض
summary: تعود بي إف إل مينا في نسختها الحادية عشرة إلى الرياض، بمنافسات نصف النهائي الحاسمة، ونزال رئيسي يجمع مصطفى ندا وأسامة الصعيدي للمرة الثالثة في مواجهة منتظرة.

title: PFL MENA 11 - Semi Finals in Riyadh
summary: Get ready for a night of mixed martial arts with PFL MENA 11 in Riyadh, as the 2026 season reaches the semi-finals with decisive matchups across the featherweight, lightweight, and welterweight divisions to determine who advances to the season finals. Headlining the fight card, Mostafa Nada and Osama El-Saeidy meet for the third time in a bout that will settle a rivalry spanning 10 years, after each claimed a victory in their previous two encounters. The event will also feature a number of rising talents from across the region.
